using System;

namespace Shapes
{
    public class Rectangle
    {
        public int Width;
        public int Height;

        public int Area()
        {
            if (Width > 0 && Height > 0)
            {
                return Width * Height;
            }
            return 0;
        }

        public int Classify(int score) => score > 90 ? 3 : score > 50 ? 2 : 1;
    }

    public class Point(int X, int Y)
    {
        public int Sum()
        {
            if (X > 0 && Y > 0)
            {
                return X + Y;
            }
            return 0;
        }
    }

    public class Dispatcher
    {
        public int Pick(int a, int b, int c)
        {
            switch (a)
            {
                case 1:
                    return b;
                case 2:
                    return c;
                default:
                    return a;
            }
        }

        public int? Lookup(int? x)
        {
            return x ?? -1;
        }

        public int Loop(int n)
        {
            int total = 0;
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
            {
                if (i % 2 == 0 || i % 3 == 0)
                {
                    total += i;
                }
            }
            while (total > 100 && n > 0)
            {
                total -= n;
                n--;
            }
            return total;
        }
    }
}
